Top News
 
 
 
 
hapabapa/iStock via Getty Images
 
 
 Wall Street's major market averages advanced on the week while Treasury yields surged, oil and gas markets continued to remain in focus, and President Xi Jinping and President Trump wrapped up their summit.

U.S. Treasury yields kept climbing this week as the benchmark U.S. 10-year Treasury yield ( US10Y ) topped 5.15%, marking its strongest reading since July 2007.

Oil and gas markets remained in focus as reports surfaced that Washington and Tehran are exploring a phased arrangement to restore commercial traffic through the Strait of Hormuz.

Chinese President Xi Jinping wrapped up his U.S. state visit with President Trump, but the trip produced little beyond a two-month extension of the countries’ trade truce .

For the week, the blue-chip Dow ( DJI ) added +0.28% , the benchmark S&P ( SP500 ) gained +1.21% , and the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite ( COMP:IND ) climbed up +2.06% . Read a preview of next week's major events in Seeking Alpha's Catalyst Watch. 
 


 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Outlook
 
 
 
 Playing the odds 
 
 
 
Seeking Alpha
 
 
Markets are pricing in another interest rate hike in the Fed's meeting next month as inflation remains stubbornly high. It's interesting that prediction markets like Kalshi ( KALSHI ) and Polymarket ( POLYMARKET ) tend to line up with expectations derived from Fed Funds futures. Such platforms may even complement traditional forecasting tools over time. Read more.

NNN REIT ( NNN ) Has Crashed, It's A Strong Buy For Me .

Bullish On PDBA  ETF And The Potential For A Super El Niño .

Amazon ( AMZN ): Market Misunderstands  Meta Muse's Threat .

Centrus Energy's ( LEU ) Drop Made The  Risk Worth Taking .

Bank of America ( BAC ): Decent Value Play Amid Sharp Selloff .

Rivian Automotive ( RIVN ) Could Nail R2 And Still Go Nowhere .

Trinity ( TRIN ): 30% Premium Earned By Strong Fundamentals .

Frontline ( FRO ): Excessive Valuation At Uncertain Times, Sell .

Walmart ( WMT ) Is Failing To Live Up To Its Rich P/E Multiples .

Revisiting VICI Properties ( VICI ) - I'm Flipping From Buy To Sell .

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Weekly Movement
 
 
 
 U.S. Indices 
Dow +0.3% to 51,829. S&P 500 +1.2% to 7,743. Nasdaq +2.1% to 27,069. Russell 2000 -0.8% to 2,838. CBOE Volatility Index +0.4% to 14.87. 

 S&P 500 Sectors 
Consumer Staples +0.2% . Utilities -3.2% . Financials -1.6% . Telecom +2.2% . Healthcare +1.7% . Industrials +0.7% . Information Technology +3.1% . Materials +0.3% . Energy -3% . Consumer Discretionary -0.5% . Real Estate -1.3% . 

 World Indices 
London +0.3% to 10,695. France +0.2% to 8,078. Germany +0.4% to 25,409. Japan +2.1% to 66,364. China -0.6% to 3,888. Hong Kong -1% to 24,510. India -0.5% to 73,896. 

 Commodities and Bonds 
Crude Oil WTI -3.8% to $92.44/bbl. Gold -2.4% to $4,320.5/oz. Natural Gas +10.4% to 3.214. Ten-Year Bond Yield -0.2 bps to 5.167. 

 Forex and Cryptos 
EUR/USD -0.81% . USD/JPY +0.25% . GBP/USD -1.11% . Bitcoin +3.3% . Litecoin +23.6% . Ethereum +2% . XRP +10.% . 

 Top S&P 500 Gainers 
Moderna ( MRNA ) +29% . Everpure ( P ) +21% . Datadog ( DDOG ) +17% . Cadence Design Systems ( CDNS ) +15% . QUALCOMM ( QCOM ) +14% . 

 Top S&P 500 Losers 
Gen Digital ( GEN ) -25% . MGM Resorts ( MGM ) -14% . Paychex ( PAYX ) -13% . Charter Communications ( CHTR ) -12% . CF Industries Holdings ( CF ) -10% .
